hotels.title: All-Inclusive Northern Territory Wilderness Luxury with Safari Bungalows, Gourmet Dining & Wildlife Safaris
hotels.description: There is nowhere quite like the regional and mesmerising Bamurru Plains. Sitting on more than 300 square kilometres of private floodplains bordering Kakadu National Park, this all-inclusive safari camp places guests inside one of Australia’s most extraordinary wildlife environments. Just 12 bungalows and retreats share exclusive access to the floodplains, each with mesh walls that dissolve the boundary between inside and out. By night, listen to the Australian bush as wallabies and buffalo wander by. Twice daily, guided shared safaris take you across the floodplains, through savanna woodland and along the Sampan to spot crocodiles and birdlife up close. Airboat and open-top safari drives await for a truly magical Australian wildlife experience. Every meal is prepared by an onsite chef and served in the main lodge, with afternoon canapes and sundowners built into your daily rhythm. Your stay includes unlimited free-flow drinks from the moment you arrive. Pour your way through a curated selection of Australian wines, cold beers and premium spirits, served throughout the resort with no limits. Sample these premium drinks in an ecosystem of quiet reflection.

hotels.description: There is nowhere quite like Bamurru Plains, placing guests inside one of Australia's most extraordinary ecosystems on the Kakadu floodplains. Set on more than 300sqm of private wilderness, this off-grid safari camp pairs understated luxury with extraordinary wildlife and immersive access to the remote Top End. Just 12 safari-style bungalows and retreats share exclusive access to the floodplains, with mesh-screened spaces that dissolve the boundary between inside and out. Enjoy daily guided experiences including airboat safaris, crocodile-spotting river cruises, open-top game drives, guided wilderness walks, birdwatching and sundowner experiences. An in-house chef prepares every meal, three per day, served at the lodge, with canapes and sundowners adding to the daily rhythm. Your stay includes unlimited free-flow drinks, including Australian wine, beer and spirits, while the saltwater pool offers a tranquil place to take in the wild surroundings.
